import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.legend(title='Sex')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df_age_clean = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
sns.violinplot(data=df_age_clean, x='survived', y='age', ax=ax2, palette=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Survived (0=No, 1=Yes)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Age')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival Rate by Embarkation Port
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_survival['rate'].plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#AA96DA'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class and Survival
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
for cls in ['First', 'Second', 'Third']:
    for surv in [0, 1]:
        data = df[(df['class'] == cls) & (df['survived'] == surv)]['fare']
        label = f'{cls} - {"Survived" if surv == 1 else "Died"}'
        alpha = 0.6 if surv == 0 else 0.8
        
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', ax=ax4, palette=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Class')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (log scale)')
ax4.set_yscale('log')
ax4.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Family Size vs Survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
family_survival['rate'] = family_survival['sum'] / family_survival['count']
ax5.scatter(family_survival.index, family_survival['rate'], s=family_survival['count']*5, alpha=0.6, color='#667EEA')
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival['rate'], 'r--', alpha=0.5)
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size (including passenger)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Overall Survival Statistics
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Died', 'Survived'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax6.set_title('Overall Survival Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add a main title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
